Common Spirals

General parametric equation:

x ( θ )  = r  ( θ )  · cos ( θ ) 

y ( θ )  = r  ( θ )  · sin ( θ ) 

The radius r(θ) if different for each type of curve:

Archimedes spiral - r ( θ )  = θ !!!

Fermat spiral - r ( θ )  =    √ θ !!!

Logarithmic spiral - r ( θ )  = ea · θ !!!

Golden spiral - r ( θ )  = φ2π · θ !!!

Hyperbolic spiral - r ( θ )  = 1θ !!!

Lituus - r ( θ )  = 1   √ θ !!!
